Goals.Goal: Always collect the existing state.json, result.json and runner-*.json files under each job's runner temporary mark-rust-tests-* directories after generic Cargo calls. Retain only evidence, for one day, using the existing pinned artifact action and a job/platform/run/attempt-specific name.
Wrap lane.yml's original unfiltered root cargo test using the already reviewed helper and existing pinned Node22 setup before any new techdebt lane publication.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve every original Cargo argument, cwd, test selection, cache mapping/key, action identity, trigger, permission, matrix, timeout, gate and aggregation. Only intended Node setup, wrapper and receipt-upload nodes may change. No helper implementation change.

Upload only the three explicit JSON receipt patterns; exclude executables, target/dependency caches, stdout/stderr, environment dumps, installers and profiles. No broad directory or recursive upload. Failure collection runs under always(); missing receipts fail the collection step rather than fabricate evidence.

Preserve all original applied and superseded archive bodies and full643f29674f5200c21239a0355c2701407a0b863c source history. New source-based retention gap is separate from the previously resolved synthetic-console reporter issue.
Root owns M046/VM046 durable application and final/archive/public integration. No release, dispatch, keychain, native app, version, signing, tag or publication actions.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No cache performance promise, recovery from non-cooperative runner destruction, new manual workflow execution or replacement of actual hosted artifact download/hash/member validation.
No product runtime, Cargo test runner, production release job or manual QA policy change. No CIF002/F003 completion claim before actual delivery and required acceptance.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All ordinary generic calls in ci.yml/test.yml and the integration lane retain JSON-only state/result/native-runner receipts, with exact existing upload pin, always collection, error on no files, one-day retention and noncolliding matrix/job/run/attempt names.

Meaningful red controls fail on missing collection and bare lane Cargo. Exact full workflow AST projection removes only validated intended additions and restores only the original lane Cargo string, proving everything else unchanged.

Tests reject broad globs, stdout/stderr/executable selection, dropped always/error/retention/name dimensions and altered Cargo/cache/trigger controls. Fixture selection includes the intended receipt shapes and excludes neighboring unrelated/output/binary paths.

Complete affected workflow/cache/governance suites, actionlint, selected target/final commands, source/hash preservation and independent review pass. No real local Cargo binary build or application is needed.

After ordinary PR publication inspect exact-head actual receipt artifacts, hashes and members; map native PID/digest/source and final reap/delete results. Source-only tests are not hosted acceptance; canceled runner destruction remains accurately bounded.
